source.body: ### Bug Description The "Stop executions" dialog on the Executions list shows a toast when it finishes. When the dialog stops one execution, the toast says "Stopped 1 executions." The text has no singular form. ### To Reproduce 1. Create a workflow that runs for some time. For example, a Webhook node followed by a Wait node with 60 seconds. Publish the workflow. 2. Start one execution. For example, call the production webhook URL one time. 3. Open Overview > Executions. 4. Click "Stop all". 5. Keep the three checkboxes selected and click "Stop Executions". 6. Read the toast at the bottom right. The toast says "Stopped 1 executions." ### Expected behavior The toast says "Stopped 1 execution." For other counts, the plural form stays, for example "Stopped 3 executions." and "Stopped 0 executions." The message is `executionStopManyModal.success` in `packages/frontend/@n8n/i18n/src/locales/en.json`. It has one form, and `StopManyExecutionsModal.vue` does not pass the count for pluralization. ### Debug Info I reproduced this on a local source build of `master` at `51f8cf6249`, not on a released version. - n8nVersion: 2.48.0 - platform: npm (built from source) - nodeJsVersion: 24.22.3 - database: sqlite - executionMode: regular - license: community - browser: Chrome on macOS ### Operating System macOS 27.0.1 ### n8n Version 2.48.0 (master at 51f8cf6249) ### Node.js Version 24.22.3 ### Database SQLite (default) ### Execution mode main (default) ### Hosting self hosted
